patthana20.4:1.1: na saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana20.4:2.1: na ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana20.4:3.1: na oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana20.4:4.1: na yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana20.4:5.1: na nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana20.4:7.1: na parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. nasārammaṇaduke
